Statikus képoszlop: a Kép mező egy fájln:
Static image column: the Image field stores a file name, and the list shows the image from it in the table cell, on the card, on the tile and in the Details window.

A missing image file shows a placeholder; an invalid file name shows no image. The catalog is read-only.
Nagy, csak olvasható szintetikus lista::
A large, read-only synthetic list: the table scrolls virtually, sorting and filtering run on the server, and the browser only ever holds a bounded window of rows.

Scroll to the bottom of the list, then sort and filter: the row numbers show the position in the whole filtered result. The bar in the value column is a project column presentation of its own.
Egy projekt által regisztrált saját néze:
A view kind registered by the project over the Readings data: a list, a chart and a summary on one page.

Select a row or filter the list: the chart and the summary follow. It is the worked example of toolkit extensibility, composed from the public components.
Deklarált aktiválás (dupla kattintás vag:
Declared activation (double-click or Enter) to a page: activating a zone opens the Shelves page filtered to that zone.

Rows expand: the zone's shelves appear as a preview under its row.
Deklarált aktiválás alnézetre: egy polco:
Declared activation to a sub-view: double-clicking a shelf or pressing Enter on it opens the full list of the shelf's items in a window, also for an empty shelf, from the table, the cards and the tiles alike.

In the item list, activation runs a registered record action: it shows the stock.
Kétpaneles fájlkezelő a keretrendszer fá:
Two-panel file manager on the framework's file service, with three fictional drives and the digital signage media store (Signage).

Browse the tree, copy and move between the two panels, upload files and folders, open text files in the editor, view images and videos, and download files or a ZIP package. Desktop only.
A keretrendszer diagramszerkesztője háló:
The framework's diagram editor set up as a network topology editor: the palette's devices and the link types are demo configuration.

Drag devices onto the canvas, connect them and save the diagram; you can add a device type of your own too. Desktop only.
A Windows rendszerleíró-adatbázis szerke:
A view imitating the Windows registry editor: the tree of keys on the left, the values of the selected key on the right.

A key's subkeys load when you expand it in the tree. On the tree's toolbar you can add a subkey under the selected key, rename or move it (Parent key) and delete it; deleting also removes its subkeys and values.

In the value list, the Type chosen on the form decides which editor shows: text, multi-line text, a hexadecimal 32- or 64-bit number, or a byte sequence. The server checks and stores only the visible field; changing the type empties the others.

Framework capabilities: tree navigation for a list view (Registry::tree) and conditional fields (visible_when).
A kulcs neve nem tartalmazhat fordított: A key name cannot contain a backslash.
Érték (bájtok hexadecimálisan, szóközzel: Value (bytes in hexadecimal, separated by spaces)
Csak hexadecimális számjegyek (0–9, a–f): Only hexadecimal digits (0–9, a–f), at most 8 digits.
Only hexadecimal digits (0–9, a–f), at most 16 digits.
Formátum: két hexadecimális jegy bájtonk: Format: two hexadecimal digits per byte, separated by spaces (for example 0a ff 3c).
A key cannot be placed below itself.
Egyetlen modulban a deklaratív lista szi:
Almost every capability of the declarative list in one module: filter panel, sorting by clicking a header, table and card views, and the edit form in the side panel.

Try it: Name, Status, Priority and the switches can be edited right in the table; the Contact phone is checked against a pattern; Priority is a project field type of its own (stars). Mark several rows and run a bulk action on them; Close task is a registered business action, and the Dialog actions show the confirmation and acknowledgement windows.

Business rule: Notification cannot be turned off for a task in progress; the server rejects it with a field error. Copy as text is a client-side record command.
1 és 3600 mp közötti egész szám; üresen: A whole number from 1 to 3600 s; empty means the media item's own time.
The list's items in playing order. Drag the rows to change the order, or use Move up and Move down. An empty own play time means the media item's own time, an empty own transition the list's transition. The Today column shows whether the item plays today.
A lejátszási lista elemei nem érhetők el: The playlist's items are not available.
Médiaelemek a keretrendszer fájlmezőjéve:
Media assets with the framework's file field and media columns: the files are on the file manager's Signage drive; the thumbnail, type, resolution and length come from the file, and Usage is a computed column.

Try the Tiles view, the search and the type filter; upload media with the Upload command, or choose a file in the form's file field. Double-click, Enter or the Play command opens the Media viewer; an expanded row shows which default contents use the asset. Deleting an asset in use warns you first and removes its references.
Mi játszódjon, amikor a műsortervben nin:
What plays when the schedule has no event: an asset or a playlist assigned to a weekday or to a date. You can choose one of the two: choosing one empties the other (the framework's exclusive field pair, in the form and in the table cell too). Date is the framework's date field: a date picker in the form and in the table cell.

Add a row for a weekday, then one for a date. A business rule after saving allows exactly one of the two, and each at most once.
Lejátszási listák számolt oszlopokkal (e:
Playlists with computed columns (item count, total length, usage). An expanded row shows the playlist's items as an embedded sub-view; the name can also be renamed in its cell.

Double-click, Enter or the Edit playlist command opens the playlist editor, where you can drag assets from the media library into the list.
Rekordnézet egyetlen médiaelemhez, a pro:
A record view for one asset, the project's own view kind built from framework components: a command bar, the MediaPlayer and the asset's details; animations (scenes) run in a sandbox (SandboxFrame).

Play, pause and seek videos and audio, toggle repeat, then return with the Back to the list command.
Rekordnézet egy lejátszási listához, csa:
A record view for one playlist, built from 61ade components only: a page layout (PageLayout) with two lists, the item's details and forms, and the shared preview beside them.

Drag assets from the media library into the list, reorder rows by dragging or with Move up and Move down, and set each item's play time, transition and validity. Available on desktop only.
A legegyszerűbb PHP-ban regisztrált erőf:
The simplest resource registered in PHP (SqlResource): one required field, create, edit, and bulk delete through row marks. The list is live data: when a note changes elsewhere, the list updates by itself.

Open the view in two browser tabs, add a note in one, and watch the other.
A keretrendszer eseménynaptára (DHTMLX S:
The framework's event calendar (DHTMLX Scheduler) as a digital signage schedule: day, week and month views, the shared event form with recurrence, and playlist events in their own colour.

Drag an event to another time, stretch it, or create a new one; in the Content field you choose a playlist or a single asset. A single occurrence of a recurring series can be changed. The Day programme (API) button shows that day's API answer and the matching request.
Projekt saját nézettípusa a keretrendsze:
The project's own view kind built from the framework's public components: the chosen day's gap-free programme from the signage_playlist.day action's answer, in the shared player; where there is no event the default content fills the day, and scenes run in a sandbox (SandboxFrame).

Step between days, or choose a day with the Calendar… command, and watch the programme.
A keretrendszer kötelező felhasználókeze:
The framework's mandatory user administration that every 61ade application gets: create an account with a temporary password shown once, and the sign-in switches in the form and the table. Switches: disabled, OAuth sign-in, e-mail confirmation and default language.

Create an account and sign in with it: after the temporary password it asks for a new one. The Disabled switch signs the account out of all its sessions at once.
Szerepköralapú jogosultságkezelés: a sze:
Role-based access control: a role groups memberships and permission rules. The protected admin role cannot be deleted and always keeps at least one active member.

Create a role, add a member in Role memberships and a rule in Role permissions. A role with members or rules cannot be deleted.
Melyik felhasználó melyik szerepkörbe ta:
Which user belongs to which role. A membership applies at once: the user sees the menu and may run actions by the role's rules.

Put a user into a role and sign in with it: the menu changes with its rights. You cannot revoke your own protected membership.
Engedélyek szerepkörökre: erőforrás, műv:
Permissions for roles: resource, action, channel (UI or API), scope and field. The choices come from a catalogue built from the registered definitions; the catalogue grants nothing, and everything is denied by default.

Give a role access to the Notes list, or deny a single field: a denied field is left out of the responses too.
Ugyanazok a szabályok egyetlen felhaszná:
The same rules for a single user, independent of their roles: an exception for one account, for example denying a field.

Give a user an individual rule, then sign in with it and see what it shows.
Gépi hozzáférés a keretrendszer API-jáho:
Machine access to the framework's API: a key runs only the chosen actions, and only what its owner may do as well. The secret is shown once and only its hash is stored; revocation is immediate and final.

Issue a key, copy the secret and call the API with it in an Authorization: Bearer header; a revoked key cannot be restored.
A keretrendszer kötelező felhasználókeze:
The framework's mandatory user administration that every 61ade application gets: create an account with a temporary password shown once, and the sign-in switches in the form and the table. The Tenants field sets the user's memberships.

Create an account and sign in with it: after the temporary password it asks for a new one. The Disabled switch signs the account out of all its sessions at once.
Több bérlős (multi-tenant) működés: a te:
Multi-tenant operation: tenants and their access. An expanded tenant shows who has access; the Access switch is a membership. A tenant cannot be deleted, only deactivated.

Switch access on for someone, then sign in with that account: it can switch between its tenants in the navigation row.
Gépi hozzáférés a keretrendszer API-jáho:
Machine access to the framework's API: a key runs only the chosen actions, and only what its owner may do as well. The secret is shown once and only its hash is stored; revocation is immediate and final. The Tenant field binds the key to a tenant, or it stays global.

Issue a key, copy the secret and call the API with it in an Authorization: Bearer header; a revoked key cannot be restored.
Tenanthoz kötött lista: csak az aktív te:
A tenant-scoped list: only the active tenant's projects show, and a new project goes there too. An expanded project shows its tasks (a sub-view), where the Done switch is editable as well.

Switch the tenant in the navigation row: the list changes to the other tenant's data.
Tenanthoz kötött feladatok hierarchiája::
A tenant-scoped task hierarchy: an expanded task shows its subtasks, and the Project choice offers only the active tenant's projects.

Select a subtask: the toolbar switches to it. The Sub-items command opens the whole hierarchy below the task in a window.
Tenanttól független, globális lista: min:
A global list independent of tenants: every tenant sees the same, accounts without a tenant too.

Switch the tenant: this list stays the same, Projects and Tasks change.
